title: Mutual fund expense ratios, explained: how a 1% fee can cost you ₹14 lakh
short: Expense ratios explained: how a 1% fee can cost you ₹14 lakh
dek: Every mutual fund quietly takes a cut of your money each year. What the expense ratio is, why direct plans cost less, and what SEBI's new 2026 caps changed.
card: A fee gap of one percentage point looks tiny. Over 20 years on ₹10 lakh, it can be worth ₹14.55 lakh.
